_README: Phase-A persistent integrity ledger. These are the CARRIED facts that do NOT recompute month to month: the clean-window anchor, the inception-pinned risk-free rate, the inclusion-gate definitions, the launch-window state-corruption and DeepSeek model-identity-splice events, and the persistent per-model status they imply. scripts/build_monthly_data_layer.py reads this and combines it with the month's decision logs and the de-fabricated clean-window series to emit the integrity layer natively. NEW findings in a future month are APPENDED here (a new integrity_event, a new persistent_model_status entry) and then carry automatically. Per-month-derivable facts (completeness gate, clean-window returns, the passing cohort) are COMPUTED by the builder, never stored here. Extracted verbatim from scripts/backfill_may_data_layer.py and the committed reports/monthly/2026-05/data_layer.json at schema-close. v1.1: the single carried state_integrity audit block became audit_certifications — a per-report-month registry of certified audit blocks. A registered month's block is emitted by the builder VERBATIM (the reproduce path); the month immediately after the latest registration is COMPUTED by the builder's conservation audit (per-model run coverage + a replay of the month's fills through the real Portfolio accounting; any in-month violation HALTS the build). RHYTHM: when a computed month's build is accepted, append its emitted audit block here under its month key — the builder logs the registration line at build time.

shakedown_window.note: Launch shakedown / state-corruption window. The first fabrication-free trading day is clean_window_start (2026-04-23). De-fab clean-window returns are based at the 2026-04-22 close.

spy_benchmark_anchor.source: First real SPY capture at capital deployment — the 2026-04-09 first post-deployment tick (the day's total_value moves off the $100k seed at this row).
spy_benchmark_anchor.note: Canonical inception anchor for every SPY buy-and-hold return and every model's alpha. The 2026-04-09 perf rows carry THREE conflicting benchmark_value observations (676.01 pre-deployment seed = the 2026-04-08 shakedown value; 680.40 first real tick; 679.91 later tick), and pre-inception 2026-04-08 rows @ 676.01 also exist. groupby(date).last() over the unstably-ordered multi-model concat resolved to 676.01 or 679.91 depending on row ordering (10.32% / 9.69% for inception->2026-07-01), a non-deterministic anchor. Pinned to 680.40 so the inception anchor is deterministic: inception->2026-07-01 = 9.61%. All four SPY surfaces (perf-table alpha, leaderboard row, dashboard equity curve, monthly _spy_eod_series) read this pin. Rationale: alpha measures a model against SPY from the same instant the $100k was deployed; prior-close/seed values hand SPY a head start the models did not get.
spy_benchmark_anchor.resolves: SPY inception-anchor non-determinism (dated 2026-07-01; leaderboard 10.32% / alpha 9.69% / dashboard 10.32% for one fixed window)

risk_free_rate.note: 3-month T-bill, annualized, inception-pinned to 2026-04-09. Applied as one uniform constant across all models and all months for the descriptive Sharpe. Emitted into report_meta.risk_free_rate as {value, as_of}.

gate_definitions.completeness: decision_completeness (api_success / records over the month) >= completeness_min. COMPUTED per month from the decision logs (varies month to month).
gate_definitions.uncorrupted_book: the model's book is free of carried phantom cash / phantom shorts. CARRIED via persistent_model_status (a corrupt book is a state fact, not a monthly recompute).
gate_definitions.model_identity_stable: the deployed model identity did not silently change. CARRIED via persistent_model_status / integrity_events.deepseek_identity_splice.

inclusion_gates.gate_scope_refinement: book-integrity gate certifies point-return estimability, not daily-risk-path estimability when residual phantom sits in a volatile name; September pass

extended_models.note: Sonnet (claude) and Opus (claude_opus) state-commingling extended through 2026-04-21.

deepseek_identity_splice.first_success_note: first_date 2026-05-21 is the config-repoint boundary; first logged v4-pro success is 2026-05-22 (n_success unchanged; flagged because the model-identity analysis turns on this boundary)

deepseek_v4_ga_boundary.retirement_impact: none — the lab moved off deepseek-reasoner 2026-05-21; zero API errors on or after the hard stop
deepseek_v4_ga_boundary.alias_echo: unchanged across the boundary — 231/231 July 2026 observations returned deepseek-v4-pro (data/model_versions/deepseek.jsonl)
deepseek_v4_ga_boundary.behavioral_shift: zero behavioral/failure/latency shift observed either side of the GA date (decision logs 2026-07-01..2026-07-27)
deepseek_v4_ga_boundary.note: the capture mechanism records only the echoed alias string, so a build swap under the alias is unobservable by design; this is the same limitation already disclosed for Gemini.
deepseek_v4_ga_boundary.status_impact: persistent_model_status.deepseek (exploratory_only) unchanged by this event; the July report's DeepSeek section must disclose this boundary with the same candor as the first splice

shorting_activation.note: v2/long-only (2026-06-01..2026-06-30) vs v3/shorting (2026-07-01+). The before/after analysis (RQ1 herding, RQ2/3 direction segmentation) keys on this boundary.

2026-07.detail: 3 of 13 decision cycles lost cohort-wide (12:30, 14:00, 14:30 ET boundaries) — chain/scheduler cause, all six models equally; intraday valuation ticks and the EOD wrap were unaffected.
2026-07.consequence: the 2026-07-24 decision-completeness denominator is 10 cycles, not 13, for every model; equity curves uninterrupted

2026-07.detail: max_output_tokens raised 4096 -> 16384 (landed 2026-07-27, effective from the first tick of 2026-07-28) per the 2026-07-27 Research ruling ratifying the budget-equity principle: constraint identity is defined at effective decision budget, per provider, not nominal parameter equality. gemini-3.1-pro-preview's hidden thinking spends against the shared output budget, so at 4096 the visible JSON decision truncated mid-string at ~150 tokens with finish_reason=MAX_TOKENS — the mechanism behind the May 0.57 / June 0.79 / July 0.51 completeness failures. Infrastructure class: no monthly change slot consumed, no version boundary, model identity unchanged. Mirrors the 2026-05-21 DeepSeek raise (deepseek_adapter.py, same rationale).
2026-07.consequence: documented segmentation boundary for Gemini's behavioral series — decision-survival rate changes at this date (completeness expected to jump from ~0.51 toward ~1.0), so time-series analyses spanning it must treat it as a regime point. Phase B validation clock: Aug/Sep/Oct 2026, each month >=0.80 completeness AND <=1% MAX_TOKENS-classified failures at this configuration AND identity stable, no averaging across months, August counted from 2026-08-03.
2026-07.evidence: scripts/gemini_finish_reason_probe.py + side_experiments/gemini_finish_reason_probe/ (arm A production replica: 22/23 failures finish_reason=MAX_TOKENS at cap 4096; arm D same prompts verbatim at cap 16384: 15/15 STOP, zero MAX_TOKENS)

in_situ_verification.window: 2026-07-28 through 2026-07-30 (first three live trading days at 16384)
in_situ_verification.halt_condition: not triggered (threshold >1% MAX_TOKENS on any day; observed 0/39 cycles)
in_situ_verification.residual_failures: 2026-07-29 had 2/13 failures, both finish_reason=STOP JSON parse errors (trailing 'Extra data' after the decision object) — the pre-existing, budget-independent failure mode; day completeness 0.846 stayed above both the 0.60 daily alert floor and the 0.80 monthly gate
in_situ_verification.alert_floor: daily decision-completeness floor alert stayed quiet all three days, verified non-vacuously: the EOD digest (same dispatch pass that runs the completeness detector) sent on each of 7/28, 7/29, 7/30
in_situ_verification.note: 2026-07-31 session was mid-day at verification time (2/2 cycles STOP, api_success true). This block is the in-situ confirmation closing the fix package; the Phase B validation clock (Aug/Sep/Oct) proceeds as specified in consequence.

clock_spec_superseded.reason: Research integration-path rule (§8): no model enters Phase B on a deprecated integration path. The lab's Gemini client (google-generativeai) is deprecated; migration to google-genai staged 2026-08-02. The 'August counted from 2026-08-03' clause in consequence no longer governs — the validation clock restarts at the first logged post-migration Gemini success, and the 2026-08-03..[cutover] legacy-SDK sliver (empty if cutover lands pre-market 2026-08-03) is discarded from clock credit. The consequence text above is retained verbatim as the committed 2026-07-27 record.

2026-08.detail: Client SDK migrated google-generativeai 0.8.6 (deprecated) -> google-genai 2.16.0 per the Research integration-path rule (§8): no model enters Phase B on a deprecated path. Config semantics preserved exactly: same model string (gemini-3.1-pro-preview), same prompts, same JSON response mode, and the same 16384 effective decision budget — GenerateContentConfig(max_output_tokens=16384) serializes to the identical REST field (generationConfig.maxOutputTokens, the shared thinking+output budget) on the same v1beta generateContent endpoint the legacy client called. No sampling parameters sent (wire body verified to carry ONLY systemInstruction, responseMimeType, maxOutputTokens); thinking_config/thinking_level deliberately NOT set — reasoning stays provider-default (RQ6 config row); no SDK-default HTTP retries (fail-fast policy preserved). Infrastructure class: no monthly change slot consumed, no version boundary, model identity unchanged (modelVersion echo verified present under google-genai; alias echoed verbatim, same as legacy).

forced_sdk_differences.empty_soft_stop: google-genai's response.text returns None instead of raising when the response has no usable part; an empty soft-stop now surfaces as '' and flows through the base adapter's parse-failure retry path WITH finish_reason forensics attached (the legacy path lost them to a fail-fast API error). Affects only the no-usable-part shape — 0 observed in the 2026-07-28..07-31 baseline.
forced_sdk_differences.thoughts_token_count: populated under google-genai (the legacy SDK reported 0/absent) — thoughts_tokens telemetry carries real values from the migration boundary onward (probe: ~4.5k mean on the replayed decision prompt); pre-boundary zeros are an SDK artifact, not a model change.

segments: post-migration August segment (clock start .. 2026-08-31): counts as a clean-month observation if it passes the gates over its ~4 weeks

phase_b_clock_spec.discarded_sliver: 2026-08-03..[cutover] on the legacy SDK — no clock credit (empty if cutover lands pre-market 2026-08-03)

pre_cutover_validation.method: arm-A replica through the MIGRATED production adapter (src/adapters/gemini_adapter.py _call_api end-to-end, nothing mocked), replaying the 2026-07-27 probe's saved production prompts verbatim at 16384 — the same prompts arm D validated on the legacy SDK.

legacy_control_arm_same_day.purpose: attribution — separates new-client effects from same-day behavior of the unpinned alias

pre_cutover_validation.residual_mode_attribution: the only failure mode either arm shows is the pre-existing extra_data signature — a stray trailing '}' after a complete decision object, byte-identical to the legacy failures (arm D 2026-07-27: 1/15; live 2026-07-29 x2 and 2026-07-31 x2). Present on BOTH SDKs same-day => SDK-independent, model-side, budget-independent (finish STOP, not MAX_TOKENS). Not created, not fixed, and not to be fixed by this migration; watched by the continuity diagnostic.
pre_cutover_validation.budget_criterion: PASS — zero MAX_TOKENS across 26 same-day calls on both SDKs; visible output profile (735/824) consistent with arm D (660) and the live baseline (852).
pre_cutover_validation.telemetry_criterion: PASS — finish_reason, input/output tokens, thoughts_tokens, and the model_version echo all captured through the migrated adapter's own metadata path; plus 8 offline unit tests pinning request config and forensics extraction against real google-genai response types (tests/test_gemini_adapter.py).

continuity_diagnostic.schedule: first two trading weeks post-cutover, checked daily (early-warning only, NO clock credit)
continuity_diagnostic.baseline_window: 2026-07-28..2026-07-31 (legacy SDK at 16384, live; 2026-08-01/02 weekend — this is the complete 7/28-8/2 pre-migration window)
continuity_diagnostic.check: daily decision completeness + finish_reason profile + visible-output-token profile vs baseline; divergence -> immediate investigation, not gate-time discovery
continuity_diagnostic.known_residual_mode: extra_data trailing-brace failures at ~8-13% of cycles (4/52 live baseline; 2/15 new-SDK probe) — expected to persist post-migration; a RATE change (not mere presence) is the divergence signal
continuity_diagnostic.new_telemetry: thoughts_tokens populates from the boundary onward — no pre-boundary comparison exists for it (legacy SDK artifact); it joins the baseline going forward

cutover.note: cutover lands pre-market on sign-off so the boundary is a clean first tick (same discipline as the 7/28 fix); both fields are recorded here at observation — first_logged_post_migration_success IS the Phase B clock start. Expected 2026-08-03 if sign-off precedes Monday pre-market; slips day-for-day otherwise.
